text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer takes on the Japanese Derby. 
An intensely fired-up Mejiro Ryan is bad 
enough, but what's even crazier is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin, a fellow front-runner. Though 
she only gave a brief greeting before the 
race, it ended up igniting her opponent's 
fire. The heated showdown begins.
